purpose: Run one authenticated local CPU-only inference service from verified offline model artifacts, isolated from target credentials, the management LAN, public AI providers, and runtime Internet access.

authorization.notes: The owner authorized this deployment dossier and accepted the CPU-local architecture. VM creation, model acquisition, benchmarking, network changes, installation, and service startup remain separately gated.

vm.guest_os: Ubuntu Server 24.04 LTS proposed; exact image and maintained patch lock required
vm.placement_status: Topology-aware experiment proposal only; no NUMA pinning, reservation, benchmark result, or VM is evidenced.
vm.deployment_order: 2 of the three NextOps VMs; after app VM definition and before live Stage 1B evaluation
preflight_requirements: Verify current host capacity, 4-node CPU/memory mapping, competing workloads, VM compatibility, and guest-visible CPU instruction sets.
Treat 24 vCPU and 128 GiB as an experiment budget, not inference thread count, user capacity, or performance guarantee.
Refresh DS-C capacity and include model versions, rollback artifacts, ESXi swap, snapshots, staging, and restore copies.
Confirm the AI VM has no route to the management LAN and no runtime Internet egress.
Define measurable Persian/English quality, latency, resource, queue, and failure targets before benchmarking.

service_accounts.scope: one local CPU generation service and its verified model artifacts
service_accounts.privilege: non-root; read-only model/runtime paths, bounded writable cache/log paths, no target credentials or management-LAN access

service_accounts.scope: controlled provisioning-time artifact verification and promotion only
service_accounts.privilege: write only to approved staging/promotion paths during an authorized import; not a runtime service identity

artifacts.purpose: Pinned CPU-only inference runtime binary/library set with build revision, compiler, flags, linked libraries, and device-startup report
Exact quantized multilingual model weights used for production answers
Immutable model source revision, quantization, tokenizer/template, context semantics, license, and evaluation metadata
Complete native libraries or pinned container image needed to cold-start without registries or user caches
Public trust material for authenticated app-to-inference transport; private key delivered separately

required_settings: one initial active request and bounded queue
model ID and exact startup flags
request size, rate, concurrency, cancellation, and health semantics

secret_references.delivery_requirement: Audience-bound internal service credential accepted only from nextops-app; never a target credential or user session token
secret_references.rotation_requirement: Support audited overlap and revocation without opening an unauthenticated listener

secret_references.delivery_requirement: Restricted private-key path or approved local key service with offline startup/recovery
secret_references.rotation_requirement: Define offline renewal, revocation, rollback, and expiry alerting

network.management_interface: Authorized local administrator route only; inference listener must remain internal and authenticated.

rules.destination: Internet, external AI, model registries, telemetry, and license heartbeats
approved local DNS, time, certificate, monitoring, and backup services

unresolved: Private IP, DNS name, VLAN, routes, firewall rules, and administrator recovery path
Inference protocol, bind address, port, service identity, certificates, and request limits
Approved local DNS, time, monitoring, certificate lifecycle, and backup endpoints
Network-level evidence that Internet, management-LAN, and external AI access are blocked

storage.layout_status: Total VMDK approved as an experiment/artifact-growth proposal; partition/LVM/filesystem allocation is not designed or authorized.

mounts.purpose: Guest OS and immutable inference runtime
Versioned verified model weights, tokenizer/template, and manifests
Pinned CPU runtime releases and one last-known-good rollback build
Model registry, inference settings, resource profiles, and secret references
Bounded local runtime state/cache; not an untracked model download cache
Sanitized inference service and performance logs without prompt, evidence, or secret content

capacity_rules: The 500-GiB VMDK includes OS, runtime, model versions, rollback artifacts, logs, bounded cache, and guest swap; do not double-count them.
Record every model/runtime file size and keep only reviewed active/rollback sets; never delete the only verified model copy automatically.
Avoid guest swap dependence during inference; record page faults, ballooning, host swapping, and memory locality in benchmarks.
Retain the 3-TB project ceiling and approximately 900-GiB DS-C free-space target; refresh capacity and thin commitments at the change window.
An independent verified artifact/backup copy outside the G10 is required for host-loss recovery.

service_order.service: model/runtime/config mounts and protected key access
service_order.readiness: Expected durable paths are mounted read-only where possible; every required checksum verifies.
Exact runtime/model IDs load on CPU with zero offload, bounded resources, authenticated internal listener, and no network download.
Readiness reports loaded model/revision, CPU execution, queue capacity, and degraded/unavailable states without exposing paths or secrets.
CPU/memory/queue/latency/artifact/free-space signals and independent artifact recovery are active before acceptance.

commands.purpose: Capture guest-visible CPU topology, online CPUs, and memory without inferring physical placement.
commands.expected_result: 24 vCPUs and 128 GiB are visible; ISA/topology/affinity evidence is recorded with host-side placement data.
commands.failure_rule: Stop if resources differ, CPUs are unexpectedly offline, memory is pressured, or required CPU features are absent.

commands.command: systemctl show --property=AllowedCPUs,AllowedMemoryNodes nextops-inference.service 2>/dev/null || true; cat /proc/self/status | sed -n '/Cpus_allowed_list/p;/Mems_allowed_list/p'
commands.purpose: Inspect effective CPU/memory-node constraints without changing affinity.
commands.expected_result: Effective limits match the approved resource profile or are explicitly recorded as not yet configured.
commands.failure_rule: Do not benchmark until guest and host-side placement/limits are understood.

commands.purpose: Verify durable model/runtime paths and available space before importing large artifacts.
commands.expected_result: Approved filesystems are mounted with sufficient active, rollback, staging, and recovery margin.
commands.failure_rule: Stop on unidentified disks, missing mounts, existing data conflicts, or insufficient capacity.

commands.purpose: Verify runtime, weights, tokenizer/template, metadata, and supporting libraries before promotion.
commands.expected_result: Every approved file verifies and exact source revision, license, quantization, build flags, and checksum evidence are recorded.
commands.failure_rule: Fail closed on missing, extra, or mismatched artifacts; do not resolve a model name or download at startup.

commands.purpose: Record native library dependencies so the offline bundle is complete.
commands.expected_result: All libraries resolve to approved local files and no accelerator/cloud helper is required.
commands.failure_rule: Stop on unresolved, unapproved, user-cache, or accelerator-only dependencies.

commands.purpose: Install the pinned CPU runtime, model, configuration, and service definition from an offline bundle.
commands.expected_result: Reproducible local CPU-only service with no runtime download or external provider.
commands.failure_rule: Blocked until the runtime commit/build flags, model revision/quantization/license/checksums, and service definition pass review.

commands.purpose: Cold-start the exact model/runtime and capture the startup device report, flags, and readiness.
commands.expected_result: The selected model loads entirely from durable local artifacts, reports CPU-only/zero offload, and accepts only authenticated app requests.
commands.failure_rule: Blocked until exact runtime flags and health semantics exist; stop on any GPU/offload, external call, missing artifact, or unauthenticated listener.

commands.purpose: Run versioned Persian/English quality, tool-argument, cold/warm latency, queue, cancellation, and resource cases.
commands.expected_result: Actual p50/p95, time-to-first-token, total latency, throughput, memory, CPU pressure, page faults, errors, and quality outcomes are retained.
commands.failure_rule: Blocked until corpus, sample count, context/output sizes, concurrency steps, sustained duration, and acceptance thresholds are approved.

commands.purpose: Return atomically to the last-known-good compatible runtime/model/config set.
commands.expected_result: The previous set cold-starts offline, verifies checksums, and passes the minimum bilingual/readiness tests.
commands.failure_rule: Blocked until versioned release switching and an isolated artifact restore are tested; do not mix runtime, model, tokenizer, or template revisions.

observability.signal: runtime/model revision, startup flags, CPU device report, and cold/warm state
queue delay, time to first token, prompt/generation throughput, full-answer latency, errors, and cancellations
CPU utilization/pressure, affinity, NUMA locality, host CPU ready/co-stop, memory, ballooning/swap, and page faults
active requests, queue length, rejected overload, context/output sizes, and deadline expirations
artifact checksum, free space, model-load failures, and prohibited external connection attempts

backup_scope: exact CPU runtime binaries/libraries plus build revision and flags
model weights, tokenizer/template, manifest, license, source, and checksums
validated resource/inference configuration without secret values
public trust material and protected internal-auth/TLS recovery through its approved mechanism
versioned bilingual evaluation corpus and accepted result records
rollback_trigger: GPU/offload or unexpected external dependency detected
latency, memory, swap, queue, cancellation, or error thresholds exceeded
offline cold start, authentication, or readiness failure
backup_and_rollback.rollback_procedure_status: not_implemented; compatible runtime/model/config release switching and isolated offline restore must be tested

required_inputs.required_before: any VM, model import, or guest change
required_inputs.description: Approved change ticket/window with exact VM, operator, artifacts, operations, and rollback authority.
required_inputs.validation: Match the approved operation digest and recheck immediately before execution.

required_inputs.description: Authorization for read-only discovery on the actual AI guest.
required_inputs.validation: Record target identity, operator, timestamp, commands, and sanitized guest/host topology evidence.

required_inputs.description: Current host capacity/contention, actual NUMA mapping, VM compatibility, guest ISA, storage latency/free space, and swap/balloon state.
required_inputs.validation: Correlate private host metrics with guest evidence; do not infer physical placement from arithmetic averages or guest view alone.

required_inputs.description: Choose native systemd or restricted container deployment and document CPU/memory limits, writable paths, and restart behavior.
required_inputs.validation: Clean offline install and cold start pass with no container socket, registry pull, or interactive-user cache.

required_inputs.description: Runtime commit/build flags/compiler/libraries; model source revision, quantization, tokenizer/template, license, sizes, and SHA-256 values.
required_inputs.validation: Reproducible CPU build, complete license/checksum inventory, clean offline import, and exact runtime/model compatibility tests.

required_inputs.description: Absolute staging path under an approved import root.
required_inputs.validation: Resolve under the approved root, verify ownership and signed/checksummed manifest, and exclude credentials/private inventory.

required_inputs.description: Absolute path to the reviewed inference binary inside the staging bundle.
required_inputs.validation: Path resolves inside the verified bundle and its SHA-256 matches the artifact lock.

required_inputs.description: Partition/LVM/filesystem, swap, model/runtime active and rollback sets, staging, logs, cache, and restore margin within 500 GiB.
required_inputs.validation: Sizing includes actual artifact sizes and low-space thresholds; mount/checksum failure blocks startup.

required_inputs.description: Private address/name/port, app client identity, certificate trust, administrator route, and approved local support services.
required_inputs.validation: Only the authenticated app and administrators reach the service; management LAN, Internet, and unauthenticated calls are blocked.

required_inputs.description: Exact runtime flags for model path, context, batch, threads, slots, queue, timeouts, CPU-only/zero-offload, binding, and logging.
required_inputs.validation: Flags are supported by the pinned revision, captured in audit/readiness, and reproduce the accepted benchmark.

required_inputs.description: Measured CPU/thread/affinity/memory/concurrency/queue/context/output profile shared with host workload budgets.
required_inputs.validation: Approved after controlled 16/24/28-vCPU or thread experiments as applicable; no hidden BLAS/OpenMP oversubscription.

required_inputs.description: Versioned Persian/English corpus, structured-output/tool cases, sample counts, latency/error/resource limits, concurrency steps, and sustained duration.
required_inputs.validation: Human-approved before execution; results preserve exact inputs, versions, cold/warm state, and measured outcomes.

required_inputs.description: Compatible previous runtime/model/template/config set retained for rollback.
required_inputs.validation: Checksums verify and the set cold-starts offline with minimum accepted bilingual/readiness results.

required_inputs.description: Independent artifact backup and isolated offline restore result.
required_inputs.validation: Restored files verify and cold-start without GitHub, model registries, package registries, or user caches.

acceptance_gates.description: Exact pinned runtime/model/template starts from durable local files and reports CPU-only execution with zero GPU/offload and no external provider.
Only the authenticated nextops-app identity can submit bounded requests; browser, connectors, targets, and unauthenticated callers cannot reach inference.
Approved Persian/English quality and structured-output cases pass with recorded p50/p95 latency, resource, queue, cancellation, and error measurements.
Cold start and fresh answers succeed with Internet blocked; missing/corrupt artifacts fail readiness without downloads, cloud fallback, or fake answers.
Saturation uses bounded queues/backpressure and leaves app authentication, audit, and non-AI diagnostics available.
Independent artifact backup, rollback, and isolated offline restore reproduce the accepted runtime/model identity.

known_limitations: No model, runtime build, quantization, tokenizer/template, license, checksum, service unit, port, or benchmark is selected or implemented.
The 24-vCPU/128-GiB profile is an experiment budget; it is not a thread count, concurrency promise, performance result, or proven one-NUMA-node fit.
The 500-GiB disk has no approved partition or artifact-retention layout and must not be formatted from this dossier.
All VMs share one physical G10 failure domain; local AI is unavailable during host loss despite offline Internet independence.
